gaps.sentence: The company is famous for its ___ (INNOVATE) designs.
The ___ (ARRIVE) of the Queen caused a stir.
He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (APPLY) for the visa took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'The application' = the act or form of applying; 'applicant' = the person.
'The wind strengthened' — the verb from STRONG.
'Directly contradictory' — the adjective meaning they cannot both be true.
